saying: Most commenters call FDA's benchmarking structure a sound starting point but incomplete, and ask for added elements: adversarial input and cybersecurity testing, human factors, citation and provenance fidelity, multi-turn and edge-of-scope behavior, and external-dependency or degraded-mode performance. Many also object to aggregate or pooled scores, asking for subgroup- and failure-mode-level reporting with separate acceptance criteria for safety-critical failures.

disagreement.text: No commenter contradicts another on the substance; positions are additive. The debate is over how far benchmarking scope should extend (foreseeable use, retrieval and orchestration layers, cybersecurity, system dependencies) and how granular acceptance criteria and reporting must be rather than averaged.
